- Patent & IP


October 16, 2025


**Joshua Harris**


## Summary


Legal finance is emerging as a critical tool in Hatch-Waxman litigation, enabling both branded and generic pharmaceutical companies to navigate complex patent disputes and pursue strategic outcomes beyond monetary damages.
